description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

IBM is hiring an Application Developer to develop, maintain, and support applications in IBM Mainframe z/OS environments. The role focuses on delivering application solutions, supporting z/OS operations, resolving technical issues, and implementing enhancements.
z/OS Application Developer designing, coding, testing, and maintaining mainframe applications with COBOL/PL/I, DB2/IMS, and CICS

Responsibilities:
• Design, code, test, and implement application programs using languages such as COBOL, PL/1, or Assembler, and databases like DB2 or IMS-DB
• Apply core zOS skills, including VSAM, JCL, REXX, TSO/ISPF, and Mainframe tools, to ensure smooth operation and maintenance of applications
• Work with team members to deliver solutions, utilizing transaction processing skills like CICS or IMS-DC, and ensuring effective application support
• Leverage proficiency in at least one language skill and one database skill to resolve technical issues and improve application performance
• Implement changes and enhancements to existing applications, ensuring compliance with zOS environment requirements

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree
• Exposure to core zOS skills, including VSAM, JCL, REXX, TSO/ISPF, and Mainframe tools, enabling effective application development and support
• Proficiency in at least one language skill, such as COBOL, PL/1, or Assembler, to design, code, test, and implement application programs
• Experience working with at least one database skill, such as DB2 or IMS-DB, to support application development and maintenance
• Exposure to transaction processing skills like CICS or IMS-DC, facilitating effective application support and solution delivery
• Ability to apply technical expertise to resolve technical issues and improve application performance in the zOS environment
• IBM will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. Therefore, in order to be considered for this position, you must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship

Preferred:
• Exposure to multiple programming languages, such as COBOL, PL/1, or Assembler, to design, code, test, and implement application programs
• Experience working with multiple database skills, such as DB2 and IMS-DB, to support application development and maintenance
• Exposure to advanced transaction processing skills like CICS and IMS-DC, facilitating effective application support and solution delivery
